articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: A CISA contractor maintained a public GitHub repo exposing highly privileged AWS GovCloud credentials and internal systems. When the cybersecurity watchdog accidentally becomes the watched.

articles.title: More License Plate Reader Mission Creep: School Residency Verification, Background Checks, and Noise Complaints
articles.summary: Age verification systems are creating a surveillance hellscape for everyone in the name of 'protecting the children.' EFF breaks down why this privacy nightmare benefits no one except data brokers.

articles.title: 🔒 A Win for Encrypted Messaging | EFFector 38.10

articles.title: Russia-linked threat group put ChatGPT to work from lure to payload
articles.summary: ChatGPT will blindly trust browser content, turning web pages into payloads. AI so smart it forgot basic security fundamentals—truly the future we deserve.

articles.title: Cloudflare's AI pivot: Agentic AI risk considerations for IT execs
articles.summary: Critical RCE vulnerability in Gogs Git service rated 9.4 CVSS lets any authenticated user execute arbitrary code. Self-hosted freedom comes with self-hosted vulnerabilities, apparently.

articles.title: Physical activity and depressive symptoms among Chinese university students: Grit as a mediator
articles.summary: Unpatched zero-day in Gogs self-hosted Git service allows remote code execution on internet-facing instances. Open source, open season.

articles.summary: Microsoft slams public zero-day disclosures while simultaneously deleting researcher accounts who find Windows exploits. Corporate gaslighting meets responsible disclosure theater.

articles.title: I set up a router-based VPN for my TV, and it's the cheap security fix it desperately needed

articles.title: Troops’ phones gave away location data to foreign adversaries
